subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): failed raw channel sends report success

question: Should `createRawChannelSendResultAdapter` intentionally reject `{ ok: false }` results in a minor release while `buildChannelSendResult` retains its existing direct-call behavior?
rationale: The code and documentation support the correction, but the adapter is a shipped Plugin SDK surface and the observable promise behavior changes for external callers.

options.title: Accept documented correction
options.body: Land the adapter-boundary change because it restores the documented throwing contract and prevents false delivery success while preserving helper compatibility.

options.title: Defer behavior change
options.body: Hold the PR for a major-release migration if maintainers consider resolved unsuccessful adapter results an external compatibility contract despite the documented semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept documented correction
recommendation.body: Land the adapter-boundary change because it restores the documented throwing contract and prevents false delivery success while preserving helper compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Plugin SDK contract and compatibility work makes this the strongest available owner for the release-level behavior decision.
